artifacts.description: Iteration-3 revision of the Staffing Matcher plan. The 6 iteration-2 findings were confirmed RESOLVED; this revision resolves 2 new findings (re-verified against the repo): F-01 (CRITICAL) — callClaude runs schema.safeParse(raw) INTERNALLY (claude.ts:132) before the core maps results->shortlist, and the authored test scripts the Claude double with a bare array (AC-04 test:66-87, AC-05 test:127-136) and a shortlist-keyed object (AC-21 test:152-158) which makeClaudeClientSpy JSON.stringifies verbatim, so a plain z.object({results:[...]}) would reject them and AC-04/05/21 could never go GREEN; FIX = MatchResult is now z.preprocess(coerceModelShape, z.object({...})) coercing array|{shortlist,...}|{results,...} -> {results,...} before the unchanged entry-level object validation (matchPercent 0..100 etc. preserved; BR-09 intact); new TACTICAL-ADR-S3-05. F-02 (LOW) — internal LOC drift reconciled to a single ~392 throughout (§1, §8, banner, output JSON). Updated §2.5, §1, Persona note, Phase 1 (S3-P1-01), Phase 3, Wiring Trace, AC Mechanism Map, Risk Mitigation, Standards/Validation. 5 phases (0-4), Spec Contracts Inventory, Reuse Strategy gate table, Wiring Trace, AC Mechanism Map, LOC envelope (~392 vs ~360 budget, overage justified), Release/Pipeline impact, Testing Strategy, File Checklist, Risk Mitigation, Standards Compliance, validation findings.

15 machine-readable GIVEN-WHEN-THEN scenarios across 5 phases for the test-creator, mapped to AC-04/05/06/21/11 and BR-03/04/05/09/12. Iteration-3: S3-P1-01 now asserts MatchResult both validates the canonical {results} shape AND coerces a bare array + a shortlist-keyed object into it, while rejecting the legacy {matches} shape and an entry-level-invalid (matchPercent out of 0..100) payload (F-01); S3-P3-01/02/03 given-clauses updated to feed the exact scripted encodings (bare array / shortlist-keyed object) through the coerceModelShape preprocess. Iteration-2 changes retained (loadModule+SYNTHETIC_PROFILES import resolution; ranking-rules+dataset in cacheableContext; real ADMIN/MANAGER/PRACTICE_LEAD/EMPLOYEE roles; toCoreRecord normalization; S3-P3-05 additive).

5 tactical ADRs (iteration-3 re-run of the deviation scan): S3-01 functional core reconciled with runMatch/buildMatchDataset wiring; S3-02 MatchResult superset adds optional rank/inRequestedWindow; S3-03 rewrite SKILL-1 MatchResult stub + extend match-staffing prompt; S3-04 canonical CoreProfileRecord + toCoreRecord reconciles the authored profile shape with the dataset output without dropping trustState/seniority/timezone; S3-05 (NEW) MatchResult z.preprocess(coerceModelShape) canonicalizes the model's bare-array / shortlist-keyed / results-keyed output encodings to {results,...} BEFORE the unchanged entry-level object validation, required because callClaude validates raw internally at claude.ts:132 (F-01; BR-09 intact). Non-deviations Zod-before-use row updated. No ADR superseded.

plan_summary.loc_overage_justification: Reviewer-finding-driven scaffolding/config, not feature creep: iteration-2 test-helper additions (~20), RANKING_RULES_PROMPT constant (~12), toCoreRecord normalizer (~7); iteration-3 coerceModelShape preprocess for F-01 (~7); the match-staffing template shrinks (~30->~18) as ranking rules move out of it. Net ~392 across the same 8 files (single number reconciled in §1, §8, banner, output JSON per F-02). No phase split required.
acs_out_of_scope: AC-24 (stale-session redirect — deferred to SKILL-6 where real auth lands; no real session lifecycle in SKILL-3)

p2_gaps: Page-02 §2.5 silent on rank/inRequestedWindow that the authored test asserts — resolved as an additive optional schema superset (TACTICAL-ADR-S3-02).

Page-02 §2.5 silent on the model emitting bare-array / shortlist-keyed output encodings — resolved as additive coercion (z.preprocess) before the unchanged entry-level object validation (TACTICAL-ADR-S3-05, F-01 iteration 3).

Authored-test profile record shape differs from buildMatchDataset output — resolved via the canonical CoreProfileRecord + toCoreRecord normalizer (TACTICAL-ADR-S3-04, F-02 iteration 2); the production path always carries trustState/seniority/timezone.

Full session/proxy.ts role enforcement + stale-session redirect (AC-24) is SKILL-6; SKILL-3 scopes the dataset + denies Employee via the SKILL-2 caller-identity seam. AC-24 is explicitly out-of-scope here (F-05), not a gap.

reviewer_findings_iteration_3.F-01: Resolved (CRITICAL) — re-verified claude.ts:132 runs MatchResult.safeParse(raw) INSIDE callClaude, before the core maps results->shortlist; and staffing-matcher.test.ts:66-87/127-136 script a bare array, :152-158 script {shortlist,shortfallNote}, with makeClaudeClientSpy (test-helpers.ts:27-32) JSON.stringifying verbatim. A plain z.object would reject both -> res.ok=false -> AC-04/05/21 unsatisfiable. FIX: MatchResult is now z.preprocess(coerceModelShape, z.object({...})) that wraps a bare array as {results}, renames a top-level shortlist->results (preserving shortfallNote), and passes {results} through, BEFORE the inner object validation (matchPercent 0..100 + required entry fields unchanged; BR-09 intact, real Zod not a bypass). New TACTICAL-ADR-S3-05; updated §2.5, §1, Persona note, Phase 1/S3-P1-01, Phase 3, Wiring Trace, AC Mechanism Map, Risk Mitigation, Validation Findings.
reviewer_findings_iteration_3.F-02: Resolved (LOW) — internal LOC drift (§1 said ~378, §8/output said 385 for the same 8 files) reconciled to a single ~392 (prior 385 + the ~7-LOC coerceModelShape preprocess) propagated to §1, §8 table+note, the iteration banner, and this output JSON.
